Package domain.controller.generationAlgorithm

Class BasicGenerator

java.lang.Object
domain.controller.generationAlgorithm.GenerationAlgorithm
domain.controller.generationAlgorithm.BasicGenerator
public class BasicGenerator extends GenerationAlgorithm
Basic generator for creating Hidato puzzles.

This class implements a randomized generation strategy. It builds a board incrementally by placing sequential numbers starting from 1 on a two-dimensional matrix representation. When the generator attempts to place a value outside the current matrix bounds it expands the board to accommodate the new position.

This generator may stop early if it cannot place the next number.
